On Friday, January 21st, Dan Gallagher, WSJ reporter, and Mark Douglas, MNTN president and CEO, joined ‘The Exchange’ to discuss growth troubles facing Netflix and Peloton. Gallager notes that Netflix is going through a painful adjustment, and growth is going to be slowerer moving forward. He suggested that Investors will have to reframe Netflix as more of a revenue or cash flow story, as opposed to a fast-growing app.


According to Douglas, this really comes as no surprise—everyone already seems to have access to a Netflix account. But this is actually an opportunity for the business, which has for years encouraged the sharing of accounts. By making that more difficult they could likely drive more subscribers. “One thing that hasn’t been explored for Netflix at all but they really should consider, and there has been rumors of it, which is to have an ad-supported offering. So that they can go beyond the 70% market share they have into really the corners of the market and get every single entertainment consumer,” stated Douglas.
